column8: ["The broad ivory field reads as a perforated backing plate; its repeated sockets give it weight but little machine character or painterly moxie.","Material separation is weak: the red and teal rims look like softly stained clay, with little rubbed-brass depth or matte-rubber substance. The ivory surface offers mostly diffuse mottling rather than rewarding contact-edge detail.","The sockets have dark upper interiors and bright lower lips, suggesting recessed cup walls under directional light rather than straight-down, evenly lit openings."]
